name: Content Sync for Trafficninja
author: Bekzodjon Norkulov

sections.description:
Content Sync for Trafficninja seamlessly integrates your WordPress site with the Trafficninja.io platform, enabling automated content publishing that drives organic traffic and improves search engine rankings.

Key Features

  • Automated Content Sync: Receive 3 AI-generated articles per day (90 per month)
  • SEO-Optimized: Every article is optimized for search engines with proper meta descriptions, keywords, and structure
  • WordPress Integration: Seamless publishing to your WordPress blog with category mapping
  • SEO Plugin Support: Deep integration with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO
  • Draft or Auto-Publish: Choose whether to review articles before publishing or automate completely
  • Featured Images: Automatically sync AI-generated images with proper alt text
  • Category Mapping: Map Trafficninja.io categories to your WordPress categories
  • Scheduled Publishing: Articles distributed throughout the day for maximum SEO impact
  • Status Reporting: Real-time sync status and error reporting

How It Works

  1. Sign up at Trafficninja.io and create your content strategy
  2. Install this plugin on your WordPress site
  3. Connect your site using your Trafficninja.io API key
  4. Configure your preferences (auto-publish, categories, author)
  5. Relax as high-quality articles are automatically published to your blog

SEO Plugin Integration

Content Sync for Trafficninja works seamlessly with popular SEO plugins:

  • Yoast SEO: Automatic meta description, focus keyword, and SEO score integration
  • Rank Math: Full SEO data synchronization including schema markup
  • All in One SEO: Meta tags and social media optimization

Content Quality

Every article generated by Trafficninja.io:

  • 2100-2400 words of high-quality content
  • E-E-A-T optimized (Expertise, Experience, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness)
  • Proper heading structure (H1, H2, H3) for SEO
  • Internal linking suggestions
  • LSI keywords for better rankings
  • Featured snippets targeting

Perfect For

  • Small and medium businesses seeking organic traffic growth
  • Marketing teams managing multiple content campaigns
  • Content managers who need consistent publication schedules
  • Agencies managing client WordPress sites
  • Bloggers who want to scale content production

Support

For support, please visit:
* Documentation
* Support Forum
* Contact Us

Privacy Policy

Content Sync for Trafficninja connects to the Trafficninja.io API to sync content. The plugin sends your API key (encrypted) and receives article content including titles, body text, images, and SEO metadata. No personal user data from your WordPress site is transmitted to Trafficninja.io.

For more information, see the Trafficninja.io Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Content Sync for Trafficninja”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Go to Trafficninja > Settings in your WordPress admin
  2. Enter your API key from your Trafficninja.io dashboard
  3. Click “Test Connection” to verify
  4. Configure your preferences:
    • Auto-publish or save as drafts
    • Sync interval (how often to check for new content)
    • Default author for articles
  5. Click “Save Settings”
sections.faq:
Do I need a Trafficninja.io account?

Yes, you need an active subscription at Trafficninja.io to use this plugin. The plugin connects your WordPress site to the Trafficninja.io platform to receive AI-generated content.

How many articles will be published?

Trafficninja.io generates 3 high-quality articles per day (90 articles per month) based on your subscription plan. The plugin automatically syncs and publishes these articles to your WordPress site.

Can I review articles before publishing?

Yes! Disable “Auto Publish” in the settings to have articles saved as drafts. You can then review and edit them before publishing.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

Content Sync for Trafficninja fully supports:
* Yoast SEO
* Rank Math
* All in One SEO

If you don’t use an SEO plugin, meta data will be stored in custom fields.

Will this work with my theme?

Yes, Content Sync for Trafficninja works with any WordPress theme. It uses standard WordPress post types and taxonomy, ensuring full compatibility.

Can I customize categories?

Yes, you can map Trafficninja.io categories to your existing WordPress categories, or the plugin will automatically create new categories as needed.

Is the content unique?

Yes, every article is uniquely generated by AI for your specific business and industry. Content is SEO-optimized and tailored to your keywords and competitors.

How often does the plugin sync content?

By default, the plugin checks for new content every hour. You can adjust this interval in the settings (15 minutes to 6 hours) or trigger manual syncs anytime.

What happens if sync fails?

The plugin includes robust error handling and logging. Failed syncs are automatically retried, and you can view detailed logs in the Sync Status page.

Can I use this on multiple sites?

Yes, you can connect multiple WordPress sites to your Trafficninja.io account. Each site can have its own content strategy and settings.
